rule: One game clock (ms in a day). Four keyed times (rise, noon, set, midnight) give a piecewise-linear sun elevation parameter, which is normalised into a sun direction (so elevation is sine-shaped). Azimuth turns once per day. A night blend ramps from the horizon to about 10 degrees below it. Sun ambient is gated by a smoothstep on sun height. Music day/night tag uses a fixed window (04:00 to 21:00) with a fallback chain (zone, then default zone; day or night, then day; mode, then standard). Skip-to-hour rolls to the next day if the target has passed. NPC routine lookup wraps the day, and if no routine covers now it picks the one that ended most recently by cyclic distance.
